dataset_semantics.historical_hotspots: UCI/figshare Porto taxi endpoint-cell proxies; not active ride-hailing stations
dataset_semantics.fuzzy_endpoint: random point on a non-service OSM road segment near a mapped signal/shared road vertex; the sampled coordinate is fixed for this seed, not a fixed reusable station
dataset_semantics.endpoint_mix: 70 candidate-candidate, 15 one-fuzzy-endpoint, 15 two-fuzzy-endpoint orders per 100; balanced study design assumption because user specified the alternatives but not their internal split
dataset_semantics.traffic: not present in this order file; generated by the separate SUMO scenario
dataset_semantics.routeable_core: only the largest strongly connected passenger-road component is used for this experiment; outside-core OSM roads remain in the base map and are not route links
